method: audit of src/mgk against the properties proven in Phases 3-4 (short-write completeness, symlink/descriptor confinement, create-state identity, boolean security checks, view/missing-view semantics, ledger directory safety, authority/resource binding, state/executor semantics). Each finding classified ALREADY_SAFE / TEST_GAP_ONLY / CODE_HARDENING_REQUIRED.

findings.evidence: Every loop raises ResourceError('short write ...') when os.write returns <=0, so no operation can report success with fewer bytes persisted. Killers: test_resource_zero_write_is_short_write_error (create/write/append), test_resource_partial_write_completes_and_persists, test_resource_short_write_completes_single_byte.

Every open is anchored to a dir_fd obtained by walking the parent chain with O_NOFOLLOW; final components use O_NOFOLLOW so symlink substitution cannot escape the authorized root. Killers: test_resource_guard_rejects_symlink_file_target, test_resource_guard_rejects_symlink_parent, test_resource_write_toctou_symlink_swap_rejected, test_resource_append_toctou_symlink_swap_rejected, test_resource_remove_created_rejects_symlink_swap, test_resource_create_rejects_symlink_target_after_binding. open_parent default-arg mutant 23 degrades to fail-closed ENOTDIR (AVAILABILITY_ONLY).

source: src/mgk/resource.py:145-149 create_bound created flag set only after os.open succeeds
src/mgk/resource.py:240-251 write_bound created flag set only after os.open succeeds
src/mgk/resource.py:167-175 rollback unlink anchored to dir_fd=parent
findings.evidence: created is False until the O_EXCL open succeeds, so rollback (remove_created / the except-block unlink) never deletes a file the guard did not create. The created=True initializer mutant (create 47) is TEST_GAP_ONLY because it only diverges under a non-EEXIST os.open failure (fd exhaustion). Rollback confinement kill: test_resource_rollback_removes_created_file_and_stays_confined.

source: src/mgk/resource.py:260-264 write_bound pre-state check (len OR hash)
src/mgk/resource.py:274-276 write_bound post-write verification (REG OR size)
findings.evidence: Each security predicate rejects EITHER violation with OR; OR->AND mutants were killed by same-size tamper tests (test_resource_write_rejects_tampered_present_file, test_resource_append_rejects_tampered_present_file, test_resource_remove_created_refuses_same_size_tampered). Post-verification OR->AND mutants are EQUIVALENT_PROVEN because the write loop guarantees full size on success.

source: src/mgk/resource.py:150-156, 267-272, 335-340 write loops advance view by written bytes
findings.evidence: view=None mutants (which would exit the loop leaving a partial file) are killed by test_resource_partial_write_completes_and_persists and test_resource_partial_write_loop_completes which assert the on-disk content equals the full payload after a partial os.write.

source: src/mgk/ledger.py:28-41 __init__ (touch mode=0o600 on first init; AuditIntegrityError on partial state)
src/mgk/ledger.py:55-85 _write_checkpoint (mkstemp in checkpoint parent; atomic rename; fsync dir)
findings.evidence: exists_ok mutants (28/30/32) are EQUIVALENT_PROVEN: first-init has no pre-existing file and the partial-state path raises before touch. O_DIRECTORY mutants (57/58/64/65) are EQUIVALENT_PROVEN: mkstemp(dir=parent) proves the parent is a real directory before the dir-open line runs. Killers: test_audit_ledger_creates_nested_dirs, test_audit_ledger_file_mode_0600, plus the whole test_audit.py suite.

bind_absent uses os.stat(follow_symlinks=False) so a symlink target is rejected before authority is issued; the follow_symlinks=None mutant is EQUIVALENT_PROVEN (None is falsy -> lstat, verified empirically). The 8 MiB boundary mutant (authority 29) is EQUIVALENT_PROVEN because request.digest() caps content_b64 at MAX_CANONICAL_BYTES (256 KiB) before _bind_resource runs; documented by test_authority_rejects_oversized_create_payload_at_issue.

source: src/mgk/executor.py:127-131 rollback branch (remove_created after failed ledger append)
findings.evidence: consume_nonce removal mutant (executor 12) is EQUIVALENT_PROVEN (default True); replayed envelopes stay denied (test_executor_rejects_replayed_envelope). Busy-timeout mutants (state 5/7) are EQUIVALENT_PROVEN because PRAGMA busy_timeout=30000 overrides the connect kwarg (test_security_state_busy_timeout_is_pragma_30000). Rollback confinement for sandbox.create_record is proven by test_executor_rolls_back_sandbox_create_record_on_ledger_failure. Stale-writer epoch rejection: test_bump_epoch_rejects_stale_writer.

conclusion: No CODE_HARDENING_REQUIRED findings. The current src/mgk production code already implements every property closed during Phases 3-4; the Phase 4 additions were purely test-side discriminators. No source patch was needed and none was made (src/ is unchanged this session).
